description: Behavioral evaluations for the cv-generator skill. Run each prompt with the skill in an isolated copy of the repository; inspect generated files and grade each criterion. Never upload private career evidence to an external evaluator.

cases.prompt: Use the cv-generator skill to create a general CV from skills/cv-generator/examples/career.yaml.
criteria: Reads the source file and creates docs/cv-generator/cv.pdf.
Uses only supported evidence, honors employer inclusion flags and preserves qualifications and employment dates.
Includes source skills, education and certifications in the required order, omitting a headline.
Parses the input, verifies the PDF and visually inspects every page, reporting the page count.

cases.prompt: Use the cv-generator skill to create a tailored resume from skills/cv-generator/examples/career.yaml for the job posting at JOB_URL.
cases.setup: Replace JOB_URL with an accessible, complete job posting. Record the URL and a local copy of the posting for repeatability; do not send career evidence to the posting site.
criteria: Reads the source and complete posting, identifies the company and role, and maps supported evidence to requirements.
Performs the applicable fit and ATS assessment and follows the artifact approval gate when required.
Creates resume.yaml and resume.pdf only if the applicable fit threshold is met and required approval is given; otherwise reports gaps and stops.
Does not invent qualifications or contact the employer, and verifies and visually inspects the PDF.

cases.prompt: Use the cv-generator skill to tailor a resume to https://example.invalid/job from skills/cv-generator/examples/career.yaml.
criteria: Requests the complete job description when the link cannot be read.
Does not invent job requirements or generate a tailored resume from a title alone.

cases.setup: In an isolated project, create distinct valid career files at custom/career.yaml, career.yaml, and references/career.yaml.
cases.prompt: Use the cv-generator skill to create a CV using custom/career.yaml.
criteria: Uses the explicitly supplied file and does not use either default.

cases.setup: In an isolated project, create distinct valid career files at career.yaml and references/career.yaml.
cases.prompt: Use the cv-generator skill to create a CV.
criteria: Uses project-root career.yaml. After removing that file, a repeated run uses project-root references/career.yaml.

cases.setup: In an isolated project, ensure neither default file exists.
cases.prompt: Use the cv-generator skill to create a CV.
criteria: Stops before preparing or rendering a document and requests a career input path.
When an explicitly supplied path is missing, reports that path and stops even if a default exists.
